row.scim_price_text: Included in SAT Foundation: $2.40/seat/mo (25-50 seats, 3-year term)
row.evidence: KnowBe4's pricing page marks "User Provisioning via Active Directory or SCIM Integration" and "SSO/SAML Integration" on both SAT Foundation ($2.40/seat/mo) and SAT Advanced; the tooltip says SSO/SAML is "included with all subscription levels."
row.notes: Tier names changed since June: Silver/Gold/Platinum/Diamond are replaced by SAT Foundation and SAT Advanced (pricing 'as per May 2026'). The June list prices (Silver $1.30 ... Diamond $2.35) are no longer on the page and are dropped. Published prices are MSRP monthly per seat on a 3-year term, by seat band (25-50: Foundation $2.40, Advanced $3.75; 501-1000: $1.63/$2.79; 1001+: quote); no annual-term price is published, so the 3-year-term figure is used. The table starts at 25 seats. SCIM and SSO are on both tiers (tier mapping read from the comparison-table check cells). SCIM deprovisioning archives users (frees the licensed seat, keeps history); SCIM never hard-deletes. KnowBe4 supports only its documented IdP guides (Okta, Entra, OneLogin, JumpCloud, Duo, Rippling, Ping); generic=true because the tenant URL and bearer token are exposed to any SCIM client. sso_required_for_scim=false is from JumpCloud's KnowBe4 page. Reporting API (read-only) on both tiers; User Event, Graph and Webhook APIs only on SAT Advanced.

plans.name: SAT Foundation
plans.price_text: $2.40/seat/month at 25-50 seats (MSRP, 3-year term; lower per-seat at higher bands)

auth.token_source: KSAT console > Account Settings > User Management > User Provisioning > SCIM > Generate SCIM Token (shown once)
auth.notes: token_expiry 'never' from Microsoft's page ('Long lived bearer token'); can be regenerated or revoked.

operations.notes: Removal archives the user (restorable); deletion is a manual console action. Group push supported with Okta and Entra, not OneLogin.

deprovision.data_retained: Archived users keep their phishing and training history and can be restored; they stop receiving tests and training
deprovision.notes: KnowBe4 calls this 'archive'. Admins are not archived unless their admin permissions are removed.

custom.how: KnowBe4 extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:knowbe4:kmsat:2.0:User (companyName, country, hostname, mailNickName, onPremisesSamAccountName, onPremisesSecurityIdentifier, userPrincipalName, lastPasswordChangeDateTime; Entra also maps customField1-4, customDate1-2, phishingLanguage, trainingLanguage)

attributes.notes: Names as listed in KnowBe4's Okta mapping table; Microsoft's tutorial shows department, division, organization, employeeNumber and manager in the enterprise extension namespace.

rate_limits.text: 15-minute global sync limit: a new sync is skipped if one ran less than 15 minutes earlier

limitations.text: Only the documented IdP configurations are supported by KnowBe4.
SCIM and Active Directory Integration (ADI) cannot run at the same time.
Email aliases are not supported by SCIM provisioning.
OneLogin: group syncing not available. Entra: nested groups not supported. Okta: Sync Password and Push Now not supported.
Users missing from the IdP sync scope are archived.

auth.notes: Bearer secret API key from the Reporting API management console; User Event API uses separate keys.

capabilities.notes: Reporting API is read-only for users and groups; no create, update or archive endpoints.

endpoints.purpose: Get a list of all users
Get a list of all groups
Get users in a specific group
Account and subscription data incl. number of seats

webhooks_user_events.notes: A Webhook API is listed for SAT Advanced on the pricing page; its user events were not documented in the pages loaded.

rate_limits.text: 2,000 requests/day plus the number of licensed users; 4 requests/second; burst 50 requests/minute

limitations.text: Reporting API cannot create, change or remove users.

onelogin.notes: Per KnowBe4's OneLogin guide; OneLogin's connector page not loaded.
